glosses: raffle off, to give as a prize in a lottery or in sweepstakes

examples.text: Ze zullen een luxe vakantie verloten onder alle deelnemers van de wedstrijd.
examples.translation: They will give away a luxury vacation as a prize among all the participants of the contest.
examples.english: They will give away a luxury vacation as a prize among all the participants of the contest.

examples.text: Het bedrijf besloot een nieuwe auto te verloten onder haar klanten.
examples.translation: The company decided to raffle off a new car among its customers.
examples.english: The company decided to raffle off a new car among its customers.

examples.text: De loterij zal verschillende prijzen verloten, waaronder geldprijzen en elektronica.
examples.translation: The lottery will award various prizes, including cash prizes and electronics.
examples.english: The lottery will award various prizes, including cash prizes and electronics.

glosses: door middel van het lot aan een willekeurig iemand toekennen
To distribute or apportion by (or as if by) lot.
To assign or designate as a task or for a purpose.

examples.text: Each candidate was allotted five minutes to make a presentation in front of the judges.
